newsitem.title: GERMANY: German cartel office-no move on Thyssen registered.
newsitem.headline: German cartel office-no move on Thyssen registered.

text.p: Germany's Federal Cartel Office said on Tuesday it had received no notice of a takeover attempt on steel-maker Thyssen AG by Fried. Krupp Hoesch-Krupp.

"Such a plan would require registration" said a spokeswoman for the office in Berlin. "We are as surprised as everyone else," she said, referring to wide speculation that Krupp was preparing to launch such a move.
Krupp has so far declined comment but banking sources have said that a bid for a major stake or the whole of Thyssen will probably be presented on Tuesday.
